response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS figure FROM media_type_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(s.bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(s.bytes_per_millisecond - b.figure) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM media_type_stats AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.bytes_per_millisecond > b.figure

assumptions.assumption: A media type's bytes-per-millisecond figure is its total known bytes divided by its total milliseconds.

alternatives.interpretation: The figure is the average of each track's bytes-per-millisecond ratio within the media type.
